summary: AmeriGas Partners, L.P. and AmeriGas Finance Corp., indirect wholly owned subsidiaries of UGI Corporation, filed an 8-K announcing the expiration and final results of a tender offer for their 5.750% Senior Notes due 2027. $468,471,000 aggregate principal (91.51% of outstanding) was validly tendered by the May 15, 2026 expiration. No price per share, premium, or advisor named; this is a debt tender. The notes were accepted for purchase per the Offer to Purchase dated May 11, 2026. What to watch: settlement timing and any subsequent redemption of untendered notes.
